cases.description: _root_execution_id (set once in spine.json, round-tripped through context like any other field) passes through as root_execution_id -- Django's n8n_callback handler uses this to walk the execution tree and compute token usage once the callback confirms the turn is done
a hard error not in the soft-error list -> type alert
NO_MATCH is a soft error -> still delivered as a normal agent message, not an alert
MULTIPLE_PROCESSES is a soft error -> type agent
AGENT_ERROR is a soft error too -- a batch record's own extraction/execution agent failure still delivers as a normal message, not an alert

state fields default to their empty/null shape when absent -- form_state/process_id/process_definition/paused_node_ids/last_error/last_batch_result/intents are gone entirely from the state object now (confirmed dead 2026-08-14: root-level working copy eliminated in favor of intention_nodes[active_node_id]; last_error/last_batch_result/intents were shipped every turn but Django's _resolve_and_persist_state never persisted them, so the round-trip to a later general_inquiry turn they were built for never actually happened). reset_process defaults false when absent -- Django's resettable-merge signal for active_node_id/last_bot_message.

intention_nodes preserved as-is when present, now shaped as an object keyed by id (restructured 2026-08-13: was Node[], now Record<id, Node>); reset_process true passes through when the upstream node set it
